method: At each change of support: gravity in the holder frame, the contacts that can push back, the open direction of escape, and the result with power removed. Animated paths are prescribed; this review does not replace a free-piece simulation.

rows.support: Carpet ahead of the ramp toe
rows.disposition: accepted: no custody is claimed before the ramp

rows.gravity: 0.71 g along the ramp toward the carpet
rows.resisting: Roller 3 mm above the undeformed piece; compression is not drawn
rows.powerOff: Rolls back out to the carpet
rows.disposition: open F2: roller compression and friction need a bench value. A stopped roller releases the piece outside the robot, the safe direction

rows.gravity: Into the hopper once past the crest
rows.escape: Back down the ramp before the crest
rows.powerOff: Falls either way about the edge
rows.disposition: open F2: measure the lowest roller speed that carries the piece past the crest

rows.resisting: Side walls to 715 mm (85 mm above the top-layer centres), front lip to 160 mm, rear wall
rows.escape: Forward over the lip and front rail under hard braking; over the walls if heaped above four layers
rows.disposition: open F6: drive a loaded hopper through 0.5 g stops and count losses

rows.resisting: Cleat behind, belt below, neighbouring pieces
Hood below and behind, flywheel above
rows.powerOff: Rests on the hood lip inside the robot; the hood begins inboard of the pinch, so the lowest point of the lane is inside
rows.disposition: restrained; the F2 compression setting decides launch, not retention

rows.support: Hood wrap to release at -150 deg
rows.gravity: Along the hood toward the pinch
rows.escape: Released by design at the hood end

rows.support: Robot hanging on two hooks at 70 mm
rows.gravity: Robot pitches rear-down about the rung
rows.resisting: Jaws on the rung's far side and the front bumper on both uprights (about 575 N horizontal at 63.7 kg)
rows.escape: Rung leaves the throat if the jaw does not reach below the rung equator under the horizontal load
rows.powerOff: A winch brake or non-backdriving drive must hold 625 N
rows.disposition: open F4: the 28 mm jaw reaches only 5.4 mm below the rung centre after seating; lengthen the jaw and recheck the reach sweep
